newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Avalanche buries six skiers in Swiss Alps.
newsitem.headline: Avalanche buries six skiers in Swiss Alps.

text.p: Three people were missing on Friday after an avalanche in the Swiss Alps buried a group of six skiers, the Swiss news agency ATS said.
Three skiers survived after pulling themselves out of the barrage of snow, but three others were still missing at nightfall.
The avalanche struck in the mountains in the Titlis region near the capital Berne. Rescue efforts backed by five helicopters and sniffer dogs would continue throughout the night, ATS said.

Since the start of the skiing season late last year, at least 16 people have been killed in Switzerland by avalanches, which often strike in remote areas away from ski resorts. Ten of the victims died this month.
